Amazigh New Year – A Berber Agricultural Celebration
Amazigh New Year, also known as Yennayer, marks the first day of the Berber (or Amazigh) agricultural year.
It corresponds to the first day of January in the Julian Calendar, rather than the Gregorian calendar we are more familiar with.
